summary: Hedged west kerb of a steep cul-de-sac stem; homes 12 m away, no room to pull off.
reasons: Hedges and trees hard against kerb

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 12 m away on the west side at both ends, a cleared building lot behind hedges to the north.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed stem with dense hedges and trees at the kerb; no ground beside the lane to pull out of it.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on this side.

sun_shade: Dense hedges shade it from the west.
